stem.text: Which statement about the development of resistance to antibiotics in bacteria is correct?

A.text: All mutations in bacteria result in resistance to antibiotics.

B.text: Antibiotics increase the rate of mutation in bacteria.

C.text: Mutations leading to antibiotic resistance only occur when antibiotics are used to treat pathogenic bacteria.

D.text: The proportion of antibiotic-resistant bacteria in a population only increases if the antibiotic is used.
